title: P04 — 먼저 도착했지만 이름이 남지 않은 큐브 (래리 니콜스 / US3655201)

beats.en: Have you heard of the Nichols Cube?
In 1957, a chemist built this toy.
Eight pieces held together by magnets.
In 1972, it was registered in America.
He sent it to some fifty toy companies.
Every one of them said no.
One of them was a company called Ideal.

beats.ko: 팔 년 뒤, 그 아이디얼이 비슷한 걸 팝니다.
beats.en: Eight years later, Ideal sold something similar.
Eight million sold in America that year alone.
Nichols sued, but lost on appeal.

beats.ko: 두 사람은 각자 따로 같은 걸 떠올린 거였습니다.
beats.en: The two men had the same idea separately.

beats.ko: 그 회사가 판 건, 루빅스 큐브였습니다.
beats.en: What that company sold was the Rubik's Cube.
